target: docker-compose.prod.yml on this build VM (https://app.arfaat.com/worldofislam via a local hosts mapping and a self-signed certificate); NOT the real production host

services.migrate: completed (alembic upgrade head, built from apps/api/Dockerfile)
services.ollama: healthy (ollama/ollama:latest, exact image); no model installed: 'ollama pull' failed with 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' (outbound TLS is intercepted here)
services.worker: running; Celery connected to Redis and ready, but it registers no tasks ([tasks] is empty)
services.backup: ran once, wrote a 448-byte dump of the still-empty database; nightly restore not exercised
services.minio: NOT RUN: quay.io/minio/minio answers 403 Forbidden to the pull; /health/ready therefore reports object_storage=false (degraded)

deviations_from_the_production_file: minio and minio-init were disabled and the api's dependency on minio-init removed (quay.io is blocked, 403).

Images were built from copies of the three Dockerfiles that add this sandbox's TLS-intercepting proxy CA to the builder stage only (otherwise corepack/uv cannot reach their registries). The runtime stages are unchanged.

The database holds a FILTERED copy of the development data: hidden tafsir entries and the 482 hidden translation editions were left out for lack of disk space. Counts shown in the stack therefore differ from the registry for those hidden items.
Self-signed certificate for app.arfaat.com; the browser ran with certificate errors ignored; DNS was a local host mapping.
